description: Storage devices: disks, backups, CD-ROM images and OS templates (uuid, title, type, tier, size GB, state, zone, labels). Narrow by `kind`: private (yours), public (UpCloud-provided), normal (disks), backup, cdrom, template or favorite. UpCloud: GET /1.3/storage[/{kind}].

kind.description: Narrow the list. Omit for every accessible storage.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

name: upcloud_list_storages
title: List storages
